description: This file defines the 'GeneralException' class, a custom exception used within the OFBiz framework, providing additional functionalities such as message lists and nested exception handling.

classes.name: GeneralException
classes.description: A custom exception class for the OFBiz framework that supports nested exceptions, message lists, and various constructors for flexible exception handling.

methods.name: checkException
methods.description: Static utility method that checks a Throwable and throws as a GeneralException if necessary.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the exception message, including nested exception messages if present.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages associated with this exception.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage
methods.description: Returns the main exception message without including nested exception messages.

methods.name: getNested
methods.description: Returns the nested exception if present, otherwise returns the current exception.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Overrides the default method to print the stack trace to standard error or specified stream/writer.
